subtitle.expenses: Purchases and running costs: reclaimable VAT, receipts and stock receiving
subtitle.investments: Partner and joint 50/50 investments: automatic rows from expenses and unit purchases, plus manual rows
subtitle.duplicates: Suspected double entries: same vendor and amount, dates within 3 days

table.jointTitle: Funded from rental income — joint 50/50 reinvestment

empty.title: No expenses yet
empty.hint: Record purchases and running costs here — the reclaimable VAT is calculated automatically.
empty.filteredHint: Change or clear the filters to see more rows.

form.dateOptionalHint: Leave empty only when the date is really unknown.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Brake pads for Xiaomi scooters
form.amountOptionalHint: Leave empty if the amount is unknown — the row stays flagged for review.
form.noReceiptHint: Without a valid receipt no VAT can be reclaimed.
form.paidByHint: A partner paying personally creates a partner investment row.
form.jointHint: Tick when the purchase was funded from the business's rental income.
form.investmentJoint: Creates a joint 50/50 investment row automatically.
form.investmentPartner: Creates an investment row for {{name}} automatically.
form.unitHint: Link the cost to a unit (repairs, parts).
form.purchasedForHint: Optional, e.g. a person or “General use”.
form.stockHint: Pick a product and quantity to book the goods into stock (purchase movement, unit cost = amount ÷ quantity).
form.stockHintEdit: Changing the product or quantity reverses the earlier stock movement and books a new one.
form.stockQtyHint: Whole pieces. Leave empty when nothing goes into stock.
form.stockQtyEditHint: Leave empty to keep the quantity already received.
form.qtyTextHint: Free text shown in the list.
form.receiptAfterSave: You can attach the receipt photo or PDF right after saving.

preview.title: VAT preview
preview.empty: Enter the amount to see the reclaimable VAT.
preview.noReceipt: Tick “Valid VAT receipt” if you have one — otherwise nothing is reclaimed.

receipt.title: Receipts
receipt.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
receipt.hint: Photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or PDF, max 10 MB.

duplicates.title: Possible duplicate
duplicates.message_one: Expense #{{id}} looks like a duplicate of an existing expense (same vendor and amount, date within 3 days).
duplicates.message_other: Expense #{{id}} looks like a duplicate of {{count}} existing expenses (same vendor and amount, dates within 3 days).
duplicates.confirmMessage: Expense #{{id}} will be voided. Its stock movement and investment rows are reversed.

void.expenseMessage: “{{description}}” ({{amount}}) will be voided. Linked stock and automatic investment rows are reversed. The row stays visible as voided.
void.duplicateMessage: Expense #{{id}} “{{description}}” ({{amount}}) will be voided as a duplicate. Linked stock and automatic investment rows are reversed.
void.investmentMessage: The investment of {{amount}} by {{who}} on {{date}} will be voided.

investments.autoTitle: Created automatically from an expense or unit purchase — edit that record instead
investments.notePlaceholder: e.g. Cash injected to the company account
investments.autoRowError: This row is created automatically from an expense or unit purchase and cannot be voided here. Edit or void the original expense or unit instead.
investments.autoExplain: Rows marked “From expense” follow their expense or unit purchase automatically and cannot be edited or voided here.
investments.emptyHint: Partner payments for expenses and units appear here automatically; add cash injections manually.
investments.addHint: Manual rows are for money the partners put in directly, e.g. cash injected. Expense and unit purchases create their own rows.
investments.jointHint: Joint investments are split 50/50 between the partners.
investments.noPartners: No partner money holders exist — only joint investments can be recorded.

duplicatesTab.intro_one: {{count}} group of possible double entries. Void the extra row(s) and keep one original per group.
duplicatesTab.intro_other: {{count}} groups of possible double entries. Void the extra row(s) and keep one original per group.
duplicatesTab.footer: A group disappears once only one active row is left.
duplicatesTab.emptyHint: No active expenses share the same vendor and amount within 3 days.

validation.qtyInvalid: Enter a whole number greater than 0
validation.productRequired: Choose the product to receive into stock
validation.notTracked: This product does not track stock — clear the quantity or pick another product
